title: review follow-ups of PR #35680: client-visible translation-fault warning slot, three unguarded i18n bundle builders, two test gaps

Filing gate: ① (L1 follow-ups of PR #35680, one card per PR) · Source: fleet · Area: a4-C · Seat: repo:objectstack#4

# review follow-ups of PR #35680

PR #35680 (`Fixes #34993` + `#35083`) makes a translation fault (an i18n service whose `getLocales`/`getTranslations` throws) serve untranslated text instead of blanking the answer. #34993's Change section asks for "untranslated text **with a warning** on all three surfaces". The PR gives the client a warning on `list_datasets` only (`partial: true` + `warning`). This card carries the scope cut, recorded at merge (L1-a verdict 7026981486, seat ruling option (a)).

## Items

- [ ] **Client-visible whole-answer warning on the remaining surfaces.** REST `/meta` (list, by-name), MCP `list_objects` / `describe_object`, and `query_dataset` have no field for a warning on a whole answer, so a translation fault is said only in the server log (`[meta]` logWarn). `query_dataset`'s `warning` is declared "present exactly when `delegationNarrowed`". Adding a slot is a contract-shape change (packages/spec + `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`): it needs its own ruling and goes as a `Feature` (new protocol key) — triage splits if needed.
- [ ] **Three bundle-builder copies are still unguarded** (they call `getLocales`/`getTranslations` with no try/catch, the shape #35680 fixed in `translationBundleOf`): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts` (~1209), `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts` (~1131), `packages/services/service-storage/src/record-file-access.ts` (~715). Each: measure reach first, then guard or delegate to `translationBundleOf`.
- [ ] **Test gaps** (L1 note 6): no fault pin on the HTTP object-tools path; the `mcpRequestHttp` branch that reads a host's already-parsed `request.query` is untested.

## Why
Business reason: an MCP client or Console reading `/meta` during an i18n fault gets authored-language text with no sign that translation failed, so a zh-CN user cannot tell a fault from missing translations. Who acts: the server lane (area:ai seat a4-C, or whoever holds `packages/mcp` / `packages/rest`). Reach: rare trigger (a throwing i18n read), no customer named.

Grade: **p3 · domain:server** — follow-up of a landed fix, rare trigger, no wrong data (text is served, untranslated). Type left to triage (item 1 is a `Feature`, item 2 a latent defect).

Dedup: search `translationBundleOf warning` → 2 hits (#34993 open — the parent this cuts from; #34876 closed). `"PR #35680"` → 0.

Related: #34993, #35083, #34876, PR #35680. Parent epic #34659.
